description: ESP32-C3 peripheral registers at their addresses, reset values and field access, and the interrupt matrix's 62 source numbers, converted by tools/importers/svd2regs.py from Espressif's esp32c3.svd (espressif/svd at be20aa1), Copyright 2024 Espressif Systems (Shanghai) PTE LTD, SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 (LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt). The interrupt numbers are the interrupt matrix's sources (ESP32-C3 TRM v1.4 table 8.3-1), not CPU interrupts.
source: converted from Espressif esp32c3.svd (espressif/svd be20aa12560889d6125d144cdb48cf615ac17628) by tools/importers/svd2regs.py; peripherals left out: RNG (its one register, DATA at 0x600260B0, is APB_CTRL's RND_DATA: the TRM's RNG_DATA_REG (TRM v1.4 section 24.5)), BB (its one register, BBPD_CTRL at 0x6001D054, is part of the Wi-Fi baseband block, whose other registers the SVD leaves out and ESP-IDF's PHY uses: esp32c3-radio models the block); registers filled in: SPI0 from SPI1, 29 registers (SPI_MEM0 and SPI_MEM1 share one register layout, ESP-IDF's soc/esp32c3/register/soc/spi_mem_reg.h; the SVD lists part of SPI0's); memories added: RMT.RAM at 0x400, 192 words (the four channels' 192 x 32-bit RAM, TRM v1.4 section 33.3.2); I2C0.TXRAM at 0x104, 31 words (the TX RAM's other 31 bytes after TXFIFO_START_ADDR, a word each, TRM v1.4 section 28.4.10); I2C0.RXRAM at 0x184, 31 words (the RX RAM's other 31 bytes after RXFIFO_START_ADDR, a word each, TRM v1.4 section 28.4.10)
